Black Friday is on November twenty-seventh. Fifty percent off everything!

text: But are those deals actually real?

The consumer group Which? tracked two hundred and eight Black Friday deals, for a whole year.
Only five of them were at their cheapest price on Black Friday itself.
Ninety-eight percent were the same price or cheaper at some point in the six months before or after.

text: Wait. So how is it fifty percent off?

You see, the discount is often measured against a high original price that almost nobody ever paid.
In the EU, shops have to show the lowest price from the last thirty days next to a discount. Look for it.

text: The best Black Friday deal? Not buying what you didn't need anyway.
